controls: The normalizer snapshots source provenance before child execution and checks the source digest again before deriving output provenance.
Successful normalization returns a distinct destination with a separate asset digest and the exact source parent digest.
A simulated child that changes the source is rejected with source_audio_changed_during_normalization.
The application ingest worker keeps the uploaded WAV byte-identical and publishes a separate hash-linked normalized asset.
Existing transform tests also cover exact original-path reuse when disabled and source immutability when transforms fail.

local_checks.application_worker_integration: test added and passed in exact-commit CI; local Windows TestClient stalled before result

limitations: The local PyAV runtime is unavailable, so native decoder integration tests remain skipped; passing deterministic tests exercise the real normalization wrapper and ingest worker with a scripted child decoder.
This is audio lineage integrity evidence, not ASR quality or clinical validation.
